about: Share clip (Dom 2026-10-28: 'share clip video that can be uploaded to social media'; src/share-clip.ts validateShareClip checks the values; docs/share-clip.md). While a boss fight is engaged the page keeps TWO staggered MediaRecorders on a 9:16 copy of the arena canvas (V1's method: canvas.captureStream + MediaRecorder, RPG-game src/clip.ts); each is restarted every 2*leadSeconds and they are offset by leadSeconds, so at the kill the older one holds leadSeconds..2*leadSeconds of lead-in. At the boss kill it keeps recording tailSeconds more (the finisher and the cut camera), stops, and a Share clip button offers the file to the share sheet (download where the browser cannot share files). No audio file work: the game audio is tapped as in V1 (feedback.stream()). Default on, no URL flag. `types`: tried in order, the first MediaRecorder accepts (iOS Safari and recent Chrome record MP4; the rest WebM). `guard`: the mean frame interval over the first `seconds` of a recording; above `maxFrameMs` clips switch off for the visit so a slow phone never pays for them. `watermark`: drawn on the video frame only, never on the page. `button`: the copy and the place of the DOM button; `hideSeconds` after it appears it goes away. `still`: the fallback where video cannot be recorded (a picture of the moment).
